properties.name: spring.h2.console.path
properties.description: Path where the H2 database web console is exposed.

properties.name: spring.h2.console.enabled
properties.description: Whether the H2 database web console is enabled.

properties.name: swagger.enabled
properties.description: Whether Swagger and OpenAPI documentation endpoints are enabled.

properties.name: codesync.version
properties.description: Application version displayed and used by CodeSync.

properties.name: spring.h2.console.settings.web-allow-others
properties.description: Whether the H2 web console can be accessed from remote hosts.

properties.name: spring.h2.console.load-on-startup
properties.description: Startup priority for loading the H2 console servlet. Lower values are initialized earlier.

properties.name: spring.h2.console.settings.trace
properties.description: Whether H2 console trace logging is enabled.

properties.name: codesync.version-date
properties.description: Release or build date associated with the CodeSync application version.

properties.name: codesync.upload-dir
properties.description: Local directory where newly uploaded files are temporarily stored.

properties.name: codesync.archive-dir
properties.description: Local directory where files are moved or archived after processing or expiry.

properties.name: codesync.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed size for an individual uploaded file, for example 120MB.

properties.name: codesync.max-total-files
properties.description: Maximum number of files allowed in a single file-sharing operation.

properties.name: codesync.file-expiry.days
properties.description: Number of days after which a file is considered expired.

properties.name: codesync.file-expiry.hours
properties.description: Number of hours after which a file is considered expired.

properties.name: codesync.file-expiry.minutes
properties.description: Number of additional minutes after which a file is considered expired.

properties.name: codesync.file-expiry.cron.enabled
properties.description: Whether the scheduled file expiry check is enabled.

properties.name: codesync.file-expiry.cron
properties.description: Cron expression that defines how often the file expiry check is executed.

properties.name: codesync.file-moving.cron.enabled
properties.description: Whether the scheduled file moving or deletion task is enabled.

properties.name: codesync.file-moving.cron
properties.description: Cron expression that defines when the file moving or deletion task is executed.

properties.name: codesync.file.direct.deletion.enabled
properties.description: Whether expired or archived files are deleted directly instead of being transferred to a remote server.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.enabled
properties.description: Whether WinSCP-based file transfer is enabled.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.sftp-host
properties.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote SFTP server used by WinSCP.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.sftp-user
properties.description: Username used to authenticate with the remote SFTP server.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.sftp-password
properties.description: Password used to authenticate with the remote SFTP server.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.exe-path
properties.description: Filesystem path to the WinSCP executable or command-line client.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.script.directory
properties.description: Directory where temporary WinSCP scripts and related transfer files are created.

properties.name: codesync.winscp.remote-base-path
properties.description: Base directory on the remote server where files are transferred.

properties.name: security.rate.limit.capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of requests or tokens allowed by the rate limiter before requests are restricted.

properties.name: security.rate.limit.refill.seconds
properties.description: Time interval in seconds used to refill the rate limiter.

properties.name: security.rate.limit.to.refill
properties.description: Number of requests or tokens added to the rate limiter during each refill interval.

properties.name: dashboard.admin.username
properties.description: Username for the CodeSync administrator account.

properties.name: dashboard.admin.password
properties.description: Password for the CodeSync administrator account.

properties.name: dashboard.user.username
properties.description: Username for the standard CodeSync user account.

properties.name: dashboard.user.password
properties.description: Password for the standard CodeSync user account.

properties.name: localonly.allowed-ips
properties.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed to access services restricted to local or trusted hosts.
